tools.name: lucas_disc
tools.title: Lucas Disc
tools.description: The Lucas discriminant L(n)^2 - 5*F(n)^2, which equals 4*(-1)^n. F is the Fibonacci sequence with F0 = 0 and F1 = 1. For n = 5 the value is -4. n runs from 0 to 4096. Returns JSON with: n, lucas, fib, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/lucas-disc

tools.name: ruler
tools.title: Ruler
tools.description: The ruler value of n, the exponent of 2 in n. v2(1) is 0, v2(8) is 3, and v2(12) is 2. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ruler

tools.name: ruler_sum
tools.title: Ruler Sum
tools.description: The sum of the ruler values v2(1) through v2(n). It equals n minus the number of 1-bits in n. The sum through 15 is 11. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, ones, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ruler-sum

tools.name: ruler_prefix
tools.title: Ruler Prefix
tools.description: The ruler values v2(1) through v2(n), written as comma-separated integers. The first 8 values are 0,1,0,2,0,1,0,3. n runs from 1 to 4096. Returns JSON with: n, values. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ruler-prefix

tools.name: ruler_max
tools.title: Ruler Max
tools.description: The largest ruler value on 1 through n, and the smallest index where it occurs. That index is the greatest power of 2 that does not exceed n. On 1 through 20 the maximum is 4, at 16. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, at, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ruler-max

tools.name: ruler_odd
tools.title: Ruler Odd
tools.description: Remove every factor of 2 from n. The odd part of 12 is 3 and the valuation is 2. The odd part of 7 is 7. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, value, odd. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ruler-odd

tools.name: collatz_step
tools.title: Collatz Step
tools.description: One Collatz step. An even n is halved and an odd n becomes 3n+1. 6 goes to 3, and 1 goes to 4. n runs from 1 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/collatz-step

tools.name: collatz_length
tools.title: Collatz Length
tools.description: The number of Collatz steps from n until 1. The length of 1 is 0, the length of 6 is 8, and the length of 27 is 111. n runs from 1 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/collatz-length

tools.name: collatz_peak
tools.title: Collatz Peak
tools.description: The largest value on the Collatz trajectory from n through 1, including n. The peak of 1 is 1, the peak of 6 is 16, and the peak of 27 is 9232. n runs from 1 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/collatz-peak

tools.name: collatz_parity
tools.title: Collatz Parity
tools.description: The parity of each term on the Collatz trajectory from n through 1. 0 is even and 1 is odd. The parity of 6 is 010100001. n runs from 1 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: n, steps, parity. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/collatz-parity

tools.name: collatz_glide
tools.title: Collatz Glide
tools.description: The Collatz glide of n, the number of steps until a value strictly below n. The glide of 1 is 0, the glide of 6 is 1, and the glide of 7 is 11. n runs from 1 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/collatz-glide

tools.name: wythoff
tools.title: Wythoff
tools.description: The nth lower Wythoff number, floor(n*phi), where phi is (1+sqrt(5))/2. A(1) is 1, A(2) is 3, and A(5) is 8. n runs from 1 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/wythoff

tools.name: wythoff_upper
tools.title: Wythoff Upper
tools.description: The nth upper Wythoff number, floor(n*phi^2), which is A(n)+n. B(1) is 2, B(2) is 5, and B(5) is 13. n runs from 1 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: n, lower, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/wythoff-upper

tools.name: wythoff_pair
tools.title: Wythoff Pair
tools.description: The nth Wythoff pair. lower is floor(n*phi) and upper is lower+n. The pair for n = 1 is 1 and 2. The pair for n = 5 is 8 and 13. n runs from 1 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: n, lower, upper. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/wythoff-pair

tools.name: wythoff_inverse
tools.title: Wythoff Inverse
tools.description: Which Wythoff sequence contains m, and at which index. 1 is the lower number at index 1. 2 is the upper number at index 1. Every positive integer is in exactly one sequence. m runs from 1 to 1600000. Returns JSON with: m, side, n. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/wythoff-inverse

tools.name: beatty
tools.title: Beatty
tools.description: The Beatty term floor(n*sqrt(d)). floor(5*sqrt(2)) is 7, and floor(2*sqrt(3)) is 3. n runs from 0 to 1000000 and d runs from 1 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: n, d, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/beatty

tools.name: kolakoski
tools.title: Kolakoski
tools.description: The nth Kolakoski term, using a 1-based index. The sequence is 1s and 2s, and it starts 1, 2, 2, 1, 1. Term 7 is 1. n runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/kolakoski

tools.name: kolakoski_prefix
tools.title: Kolakoski Prefix
tools.description: The first n Kolakoski terms as a string of the digits 1 and 2. The first 10 terms are 1221121221. n runs from 1 to 4096. Returns JSON with: n, bits. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/kolakoski-prefix

tools.name: kolakoski_sum
tools.title: Kolakoski Sum
tools.description: The sum of the first n Kolakoski terms. The sum of the first 10 terms is 15. n runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, count, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/kolakoski-sum

tools.name: kolakoski_run
tools.title: Kolakoski Run
tools.description: The Kolakoski run that contains the 1-based index n. A run has length 1 or 2. Index 1 is a single 1. Index 2 starts two 2s. n runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, value, start, length. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/kolakoski-run

tools.name: kolakoski_check
tools.title: Kolakoski Check
tools.description: Whether a string of the digits 1 and 2 is a prefix of the Kolakoski sequence. 122112 is a prefix. An empty string, or any other character, is rejected. The string stops at 512 characters. Returns JSON with: match, n. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/kolakoski-check

tools.name: carmichael
tools.title: Carmichael
tools.description: Carmichael's lambda of n, the exponent of the multiplicative group mod n. lambda(1) is 1, lambda(8) is 2, lambda(p) is p-1, and lambda(15) is 4. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/carmichael

tools.name: jordan_totient
tools.title: Jordan Totient
tools.description: The Jordan totient J(k, n). J(1, n) is Euler's totient. J(1, 6) is 2 and J(2, 6) is 24. k runs from 1 to 12 and n runs from 1 to 1000000. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: k, n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/jordan-totient

tools.name: dedekind_psi
tools.title: Dedekind Psi
tools.description: Dedekind's psi function, n times the product of (1+1/p) over the distinct prime factors of n. psi(1) is 1, psi(2) is 3, and psi(6) is 12. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/dedekind-psi

tools.name: aliquot
tools.title: Aliquot
tools.description: The aliquot part of n, the sum of proper divisors. The aliquot part of 1 is 0, of 9 is 4, and of 6 is 6. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/aliquot

tools.name: perfect_check
tools.title: Perfect Check
tools.description: Classify n from its divisor sum. 6 and 28 are perfect. 12 is abundant. 8 is deficient. The class is perfect, abundant, or deficient. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, sigma, class. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/perfect-check

tools.name: hermite
tools.title: Hermite
tools.description: The physicist Hermite polynomial H(n, x) at an integer x. H(0, x) is 1, H(1, x) is 2x, H(2, 1) is 2, and H(3, 1) is -4. n runs from 0 to 32 and x from -1000 to 1000. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, x, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/hermite

tools.name: hermite_prob
tools.title: Hermite Prob
tools.description: The probabilist Hermite polynomial He(n, x) at an integer x. He(0, x) is 1, He(1, x) is x, and He(2, 1) is 0. n runs from 0 to 32 and x from -1000 to 1000. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, x, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/hermite-prob

tools.name: laguerre
tools.title: Laguerre
tools.description: The Laguerre polynomial L(n, x) at an integer x, as a reduced fraction. L(n, 0) is 1, L(1, 1) is 0, and L(2, 1) is -1/2. n runs from 0 to 32 and x from -1000 to 1000. Returns JSON with: n, x, num, den. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/laguerre

tools.name: legendre_pol
tools.title: Legendre Pol
tools.description: The Legendre polynomial P(n, x) at an integer x, as a reduced fraction. P(n, 1) is 1, and P(2, 2) is 11/2. n runs from 0 to 32 and x from -1000 to 1000. Returns JSON with: n, x, num, den. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/legendre-pol

tools.name: hermite_deriv
tools.title: Hermite Deriv
tools.description: The derivative of the physicist Hermite polynomial, H'(n, x) = 2*n*H(n-1, x). At n = 3 and x = 1 the derivative is 12. n runs from 1 to 32 and x from -1000 to 1000. Returns JSON with: n, x, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/hermite-deriv

tools.name: stirling1
tools.title: Stirling1
tools.description: The signed Stirling number of the first kind s(n, k). s(4, 2) is 11 and s(5, 2) is -50. s(n, 0) is 0 for n > 0. n runs from 0 to 64, and k must not pass n. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/stirling1

tools.name: stirling1_unsigned
tools.title: Stirling1 Unsigned
tools.description: The unsigned Stirling number of the first kind, the absolute value of s(n, k). It counts permutations of n with k cycles. c(5, 2) is 50 and c(5, 1) is 24. n runs from 0 to 64. Returns JSON with: n, k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/stirling1-unsigned

tools.name: stirling1_row
tools.title: Stirling1 Row
tools.description: Row n of the signed Stirling numbers of the first kind, from s(n, 0) through s(n, n). The absolute values sum to n!. Row 4 is 0, -6, 11, -6, 1. n runs from 0 to 64. Returns JSON with: n, row, factorial. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/stirling1-row

tools.name: stirling1_rec
tools.title: Stirling1 Rec
tools.description: One step of s(n, k) = s(n-1, k-1) - (n-1)*s(n-1, k). For n = 5 and k = 2, the previous term is -6, the scaled term is 44, and the value is -50. n runs from 1 to 64 and k from 1 to n. Returns JSON with: n, k, left, scaled, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/stirling1-rec

tools.name: subfactorial
tools.title: Subfactorial
tools.description: The subfactorial !n, the number of derangements of n objects. !0 is 1, !1 is 0, !2 is 1, and !5 is 44. n runs from 0 to 4096. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/subfactorial

tools.name: zeckendorf
tools.title: Zeckendorf
tools.description: The Zeckendorf representation of n. Fibonacci numbers start F1 = 1, F2 = 1, F3 = 2, and no two used indices are consecutive. 4 is F4 + F2, and 100 is F11 + F6 + F4. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, indices, parts, bits. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/zeckendorf

tools.name: zeckendorf_sum
tools.title: Zeckendorf Sum
tools.description: Sum Fibonacci numbers by index, using F1 = 1 and F2 = 1. Indices must be at least 2 and no two may be consecutive. Indices 11, 6, and 4 sum to 100. An empty list is rejected. At most 64 indices, each at most 512. Returns JSON with: indices, parts, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/zeckendorf-sum

tools.name: zeckendorf_bits
tools.title: Zeckendorf Bits
tools.description: The Zeckendorf bit string of n, from the largest used Fibonacci index down to F2. The bit string of 1 is 1, of 4 is 101, and of 100 is 1000010100. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, bits. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/zeckendorf-bits

tools.name: fibword
tools.title: Fibword
tools.description: The nth bit of the infinite Fibonacci word, starting at n = 0. The word is the fixed point of 0 to 01 and 1 to 0, and it starts 01001010. n runs from 0 to 99999. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/fibword

tools.name: fibword_prefix
tools.title: Fibword Prefix
tools.description: The first n bits of the Fibonacci word. The first 8 bits are 01001010, and the first 16 bits are 0100101001001010. n runs from 1 to 4096. Returns JSON with: n, bits. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/fibword-prefix

tools.name: little_omega
tools.title: Little Omega
tools.description: The number of distinct prime factors of n. omega(1) is 0, omega(4) is 1, and omega(30) is 3. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/little-omega

tools.name: big_omega
tools.title: Big Omega
tools.description: The number of prime factors of n counted with multiplicity. Omega(1) is 0, Omega(4) is 2, and Omega(12) is 3. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/big-omega

tools.name: radical
tools.title: Radical
tools.description: The radical of n, the product of its distinct prime factors. rad(1) is 1, rad(12) is 6, and rad(36) is 6. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/radical

tools.name: sopfr
tools.title: Sopfr
tools.description: The sum of prime factors of n with multiplicity. sopfr(1) is 0, sopfr(12) is 7, and sopfr(36) is 10. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sopfr

tools.name: squarefree
tools.title: Squarefree
tools.description: Whether n is squarefree, together with its radical. 1 and 30 are squarefree. 4 and 12 are not. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, squarefree, radical. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/squarefree

tools.name: bernoulli
tools.title: Bernoulli
tools.description: The nth Bernoulli number as a reduced fraction, from the Akiyama-Tanigawa algorithm. B0 is 1, B1 is 1/2, B2 is 1/6, and B4 is -1/30. Odd indices after 1 are 0. n runs from 0 to 40. Returns JSON with: n, num, den. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/bernoulli

tools.name: bernoulli_denom
tools.title: Bernoulli Denom
tools.description: The von Staudt denominator of B(m) for even m at least 2: the product of primes p such that p-1 divides m. The denominator of B2 is 6, and of B4 is 30. An odd m is rejected. m runs from 2 to 40. Returns JSON with: m, primes, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/bernoulli-denom

tools.name: von_staudt
tools.title: Von Staudt
tools.description: The von Staudt-Clausen integer. For even m at least 2, B(m) plus the sum of 1/p over primes p with p-1 dividing m is an integer. For m = 2, 4, 6, and 10 that integer is 1. An odd m is rejected. Returns JSON with: m, primes, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/von-staudt

tools.name: tangent_number
tools.title: Tangent Number
tools.description: The nth tangent number. T1 is 1, T2 is 2, T3 is 16, and T4 is 272. It is read from the Bernoulli number B(2n). n runs from 1 to 20. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/tangent-number

tools.name: bernoulli_sum
tools.title: Bernoulli Sum
tools.description: The sum of Bernoulli numbers B0 through Bn, as a reduced fraction. The sum through B1 is 3/2, and through B2 is 5/3. n runs from 0 to 40. Returns JSON with: n, num, den. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/bernoulli-sum

tools.name: isqrt
tools.title: Isqrt
tools.description: The integer square root of a non-negative decimal integer, the greatest r with r^2 not exceeding n. isqrt(0) is 0 and isqrt(10) is 3. A leading zero is rejected. n has at most 600 digits. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/isqrt

tools.name: icbrt
tools.title: Icbrt
tools.description: The integer cube root of a non-negative decimal integer, the greatest r with r^3 not exceeding n. icbrt(26) is 2 and icbrt(27) is 3. A leading zero is rejected. n has at most 600 digits. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/icbrt

tools.name: isquare
tools.title: Isquare
tools.description: Whether a non-negative decimal integer is a perfect square, and the root when it is. 16 is 4 squared. 15 is not a square. A leading zero is rejected. n has at most 600 digits. Returns JSON with: n, square, root. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/isquare

tools.name: ipow
tools.title: Ipow
tools.description: The integer power base^exp. 2^10 is 1024, and (-2)^5 is -32. 0^0 is 1. exp runs from 0 to 256. The base has at most 80 digits. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: base, exp, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ipow

tools.name: perfect_power
tools.title: Perfect Power
tools.description: Whether n is a perfect power a^k with k at least 2. The base is the smallest such a, so the exponent is the largest. 16 is 2^4, 36 is 6^2, and 7 is not a perfect power. 0 and 1 use exponent 2. A leading zero is rejected. n has at most 80 digits. Returns JSON with: n, perfect, base, exp. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/perfect-power

tools.name: recaman
tools.title: Recaman
tools.description: The nth Recamán term. a(0) is 0. Each later term steps back by n when that value is positive and new, and otherwise steps forward by n. a(4) is 2 and a(6) is 13. n runs from 0 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/recaman

tools.name: recaman_seen
tools.title: Recaman Seen
tools.description: Whether value appears in Recamán's sequence from a(0) through a(limit), and the smallest index if it does. 2 appears at index 4. 4 does not appear by index 20. limit runs from 0 to 100000. Returns JSON with: value, limit, seen, index. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/recaman-seen

tools.name: golomb
tools.title: Golomb
tools.description: The nth Golomb term, 1-based. a(1) is 1, a(n) counts how often n will appear, and a(6) is 4. The sequence starts 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 4. n runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/golomb

tools.name: golomb_sum
tools.title: Golomb Sum
tools.description: The sum of the first n Golomb terms, from a(1) through a(n). The sum of the first 5 terms is 11. n runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/golomb-sum

tools.name: golomb_inverse
tools.title: Golomb Inverse
tools.description: The smallest index n with Golomb a(n) equal to k. Index 1 holds 1, index 4 holds 3, and index 6 holds 4. k runs from 1 to 5000. Returns JSON with: k, n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/golomb-inverse

tools.name: hockey_stick
tools.title: Hockey Stick
tools.description: The hockey-stick sum of binomial coefficients C(i, r) from i = r through n. It equals C(n+1, r+1). The sum for r = 2 and n = 5 is 20. r must not pass n. Both run from 0 to 1024. Returns JSON with: n, r, value, closed. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/hockey-stick

tools.name: vandermonde
tools.title: Vandermonde
tools.description: The Vandermonde convolution. The sum of C(m, k)*C(n, r-k) equals C(m+n, r). For m = 3, n = 3, and r = 2 the value is 15. m and n run from 0 to 256, and r must not pass m+n. Returns JSON with: m, n, r, value, closed. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/vandermonde

tools.name: stars_bars
tools.title: Stars Bars
tools.description: The number of ways to place n identical items into k distinct bins, which is C(n+k-1, n). Three items in two bins can be placed in 4 ways. n runs from 0 to 1024 and k runs from 1 to 1024. Returns JSON with: n, k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/stars-bars

tools.name: multichoose
tools.title: Multichoose
tools.description: The number of ways to choose k elements from n types with repetition, which is C(n+k-1, k). Choosing 2 from 3 types can be done in 6 ways. Choosing nothing can be done in 1 way. n and k run from 0 to 1024. Returns JSON with: n, k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/multichoose

tools.name: kummer
tools.title: Kummer
tools.description: The number of carries when a and b are added in prime base p. By Kummer, that is the exponent of p in C(a+b, a). Adding 5 and 3 in base 2 makes 3 carries. A composite base is rejected. a and b run from 0 to 1000000000000, and p runs from 2 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: a, b, p, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/kummer

tools.name: double_factorial
tools.title: Double Factorial
tools.description: The double factorial n!!. Even n uses the even factors down to 2, and odd n uses the odd factors down to 1. 0!! is 1, 6!! is 48, and 7!! is 105. n runs from 0 to 4096. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/double-factorial

tools.name: primorial
tools.title: Primorial
tools.description: The primorial of n, the product of the primes less than or equal to n. The primorial of 1 is 1, of 10 is 210, and of 11 is 2310. n runs from 1 to 5000. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/primorial

tools.name: falling
tools.title: Falling
tools.description: The falling factorial (n)_k = n*(n-1)*...*(n-k+1). (5)_3 is 60, (5)_0 is 1, and (5)_6 is 0. n runs from 0 to 100000 and k runs from 0 to 512. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/falling

tools.name: rising
tools.title: Rising
tools.description: The rising factorial n^(k) = n*(n+1)*...*(n+k-1). 5^(3) is 210, and 5^(0) is 1. n runs from 0 to 100000 and k runs from 0 to 512. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/rising

tools.name: factorial_mod
tools.title: Factorial Mod
tools.description: n! mod m. 0! is 1, so 0! mod 5 is 1. 10! mod 97 is 30. The modulus is a positive decimal integer, and zero is rejected. n runs from 0 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, mod, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/factorial-mod

tools.name: sl2_mul
tools.title: Sl2 Mul
tools.description: The product of two integer 2 by 2 matrices, each written as [a, b, c, d]. [1, 1, 0, 1] times [1, 0, 1, 1] is [2, 1, 1, 1]. Each entry runs from -1000000 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sl2-mul

tools.name: sl2_pow
tools.title: Sl2 Pow
tools.description: The non-negative integer power of a 2 by 2 integer matrix. The exponent 0 is the identity [1, 0, 0, 1]. [1, 1, 0, 1] to the fifth is [1, 5, 0, 1]. [1, 1, 1, 0] to the fifth is [8, 5, 5, 3]. The exponent runs from 0 to 64. Returns JSON with: exp, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sl2-pow

tools.name: sl2_det
tools.title: Sl2 Det
tools.description: The determinant ad-bc of a 2 by 2 integer matrix [a, b, c, d]. The determinant of [1, 1, 0, 1] is 1, and the determinant of [2, 0, 0, 3] is 6. Returns JSON with: value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sl2-det

tools.name: sl2_inv
tools.title: Sl2 Inv
tools.description: The inverse of a 2 by 2 integer matrix whose determinant is 1 or -1. The inverse of [1, 1, 0, 1] is [1, -1, 0, 1]. Any other determinant is rejected. Returns JSON with: det, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sl2-inv

tools.name: sl2_trace
tools.title: Sl2 Trace
tools.description: The trace a+d of a 2 by 2 integer matrix [a, b, c, d]. The trace of [1, 1, 0, 1] is 2, and the trace of [8, 5, 5, 3] is 11. Returns JSON with: value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sl2-trace

tools.name: frobenius
tools.title: Frobenius
tools.description: The Frobenius number of two coprime integers a and b, each at least 2. It is ab-a-b, the largest integer that cannot be made with non-negative combinations. For 2 and 5 it is 3. For 4 and 7 it is 17. A pair that is not coprime is rejected. Returns JSON with: a, b, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/frobenius

tools.name: coin_count
tools.title: Coin Count
tools.description: How many positive integers cannot be made with coprime denominations a and b. The count is (a-1)*(b-1)/2. For 2 and 5 it is 2. For 4 and 7 it is 9. A pair that is not coprime is rejected. Returns JSON with: a, b, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/coin-count

tools.name: coin_check
tools.title: Coin Check
tools.description: Whether n can be made with non-negative counts of coins a and b. 10 can be made with 2 and 5. 3 cannot. 0 can. a and b run from 1 to 10000, and n runs from 0 to 100000. Returns JSON with: a, b, n, possible. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/coin-check

tools.name: coin_ways
tools.title: Coin Ways
tools.description: The number of non-negative integer solutions of a*x + b*y = n. Order of summands does not matter. There are 2 ways to make 10 with 2 and 5, and 0 ways to make 3. a and b run from 1 to 10000, and n runs from 0 to 100000. Returns JSON with: a, b, n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/coin-ways

tools.name: coin_min
tools.title: Coin Min
tools.description: The fewest coins of denominations a and b that sum to n. Making 10 with 2 and 5 takes 2 coins. An amount that cannot be made is rejected. a and b run from 1 to 10000, and n runs from 0 to 100000. Returns JSON with: a, b, n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/coin-min

tools.name: look_say
tools.title: Look Say
tools.description: The nth look-and-say term, starting from 1. Term 1 is 1, term 4 is 1211, and term 5 is 111221. Each run of k copies of a digit d becomes the digits of k followed by d. n runs from 1 to 25. Returns JSON with: n, value, length. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/look-say

tools.name: look_say_step
tools.title: Look Say Step
tools.description: One look-and-say step on a digit string. 1 becomes 11, and 1211 becomes 111221. Two 2s become 22. An empty string, or a character that is not a digit, is rejected. The string stops at 4096 characters. Returns JSON with: digits, value, length. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/look-say-step

tools.name: look_say_len
tools.title: Look Say Len
tools.description: The number of digits in the nth look-and-say term, starting from 1. Term 1 has length 1, term 5 has length 6, and term 8 has length 10. n runs from 1 to 25. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/look-say-len

tools.name: look_say_digit
tools.title: Look Say Digit
tools.description: One digit of the nth look-and-say term. The index starts at 0. Term 5 is 111221, so index 3 is 2. An index past the end is rejected. n runs from 1 to 25. Returns JSON with: n, i, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/look-say-digit

tools.name: look_say_count
tools.title: Look Say Count
tools.description: How many times a digit occurs in the nth look-and-say term. Term 5 is 111221, so it has four 1s and two 2s. A digit from 4 through 9 occurs zero times in the classic sequence. n runs from 1 to 25, and the digit runs from 0 to 9. Returns JSON with: n, digit, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/look-say-count

tools.name: hof_q
tools.title: Hof Q
tools.description: The nth Hofstadter Q term. Q(1) and Q(2) are 1, and Q(n) = Q(n-Q(n-1)) + Q(n-Q(n-2)). Q(10) is 6, and Q(16) is 9. n runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/hof-q

tools.name: hof_q_sum
tools.title: Hof Q Sum
tools.description: The sum of Hofstadter Q terms Q(1) through Q(n). The sum through Q(10) is 36, and the sum through Q(20) is 129. n runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/hof-q-sum

tools.name: hof_q_prefix
tools.title: Hof Q Prefix
tools.description: The first n Hofstadter Q terms, from Q(1) through Q(n), written as comma-separated integers. The first 10 terms are 1,1,2,3,3,4,5,5,6,6. n runs from 1 to 4096. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/hof-q-prefix

tools.name: hof_g
tools.title: Hof G
tools.description: The nth Hofstadter G term. G(0) is 0, and G(n) = n - G(G(n-1)). G(1) is 1, and G(10) is 6. n runs from 0 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/hof-g

tools.name: hof_h
tools.title: Hof H
tools.description: The nth Hofstadter H term. H(0) is 0, and H(n) = n - H(H(H(n-1))). H(1) is 1, and H(10) is 7. n runs from 0 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/hof-h

tools.name: hof_conway
tools.title: Hof Conway
tools.description: The nth Hofstadter-Conway term. a(1) and a(2) are 1, and a(n) = a(a(n-1)) + a(n-a(n-1)). a(5) is 3, and a(10) is 6. n runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/hof-conway

tools.name: hof_conway_sum
tools.title: Hof Conway Sum
tools.description: The sum of Hofstadter-Conway terms a(1) through a(n). The sum through a(10) is 32, and the sum through a(30) is 266. n runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, value. tools.name: hof_male
tools.title: Hof Male

Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/hof-male

tools.name: hof_female

tools.name: hof_pair
tools.title: Hof Pair

tools.name: tetranacci

tools.title: Entringer
tools.description: The Entringer number E(n, k). E(1, 1) is 1, and E(n, k) = E(n, k-1) + E(n-1, n-k). E(5, 2) is 10, and E(6, 3) is 46. The last entry E(n, n) is the zigzag number a(n). n and k run from 1 to 40, and k must not pass n. Returns JSON with: n, k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/entringer

tools.name: genocchi
tools.title: Genocchi
tools.description: The nth Genocchi number |G(2n)|, from G(2n) = 2*(1-4^n)*B(2n) with B(1) = +1/2. The first four absolute values are 1, 1, 3, and 17. signed is (-1)^n times that value. n runs from 1 to 20. Past 15 digits a value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value, signed. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/genocchi

tools.name: euler_secant
tools.title: Euler Secant
tools.description: The nth secant number, the signed Euler number E(2n) = (-1)^n * a(2n). E(0) is 1, E(2) is -1, E(4) is 5, and E(6) is -61. n runs from 0 to 20. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/euler-secant

tools.name: involution
tools.title: Involution
tools.description: The number of involutions of n objects. I(0) and I(1) are 1, and I(n) = I(n-1) + (n-1)*I(n-2). I(5) is 26, and I(10) is 9496. n runs from 0 to 100. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/involution

tools.name: involution_sum
tools.title: Involution Sum
tools.description: The sum of involution numbers from lo through hi inclusive. The sum from I(0) through I(10) is 13232. lo must not pass hi. Each index runs from 0 to 100. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: lo, hi, count, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/involution-sum

tools.name: involution_mod
tools.title: Involution Mod
tools.description: I(n) mod m, the involution number reduced by a positive modulus. Zero is rejected. n runs from 0 to 100. The residue is smaller than the modulus. Returns JSON with: n, mod, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/involution-mod

tools.name: rencontres
tools.title: Rencontres
tools.description: The rencontres number D(n, k), the permutations of n objects with k fixed points. D(n, k) = C(n, k) * !(n-k). D(5, 0) is 44, and D(5, 2) is 20. n runs from 0 to 100, and k runs from 0 to n. Returns JSON with: n, k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/rencontres

tools.name: involution_fixed
tools.title: Involution Fixed
tools.description: The number of involutions of n objects with exactly k fixed points. It is 0 when n-k is odd. For n = 5 and k = 1 the count is 15, and for n = 5 and k = 5 it is 1. n runs from 0 to 100, and k runs from 0 to n. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/involution-fixed

tools.name: fubini
tools.title: Fubini
tools.description: The nth Fubini number, the ordered partitions of an n-element set. a(0) is 1, a(2) is 3, a(3) is 13, and a(5) is 541. n runs from 0 to 20. Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/fubini

tools.name: fubini_sum
tools.title: Fubini Sum

tools.name: fubini_mod
tools.title: Fubini Mod

tools.name: lah
tools.title: Lah

Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/lah

tools.name: lah_row
tools.title: Lah Row

Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/lah-row

tools.name: riordan
tools.title: Riordan
tools.description: The nth Riordan number. R(0) is 1, R(1) is 0, and (n+1)*R(n) = (n-1)*(2*R(n-1) + 3*R(n-2)) for n at least 2. R(4) is 3, and R(6) is 15. n runs from 0 to 80. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). tools.name: riordan_sum
tools.title: Riordan Sum
tools.description: The sum of Riordan numbers from lo through hi inclusive. The sum from R(0) through R(10) is 989. lo must not pass hi. Each index runs from 0 to 80. Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/riordan-sum

tools.name: riordan_mod
tools.title: Riordan Mod
tools.description: R(n) mod m for the Riordan numbers. The modulus is a positive decimal integer, and zero is rejected. n runs from 0 to 80. The residue is smaller than the modulus. Returns JSON with: n, mod, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/riordan-mod

tools.name: fine
tools.title: Fine
tools.description: The nth Fine number. F(0) is 1, F(1) is 0, F(2) is 1, and F(6) is 57. For n at least 1, F(n) = C(n) - sum of C(i)*F(n-1-i) over i from 0 to n-1, with C the Catalan numbers. n runs from 0 to 80. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/fine

tools.name: fine_sum
tools.title: Fine Sum
tools.description: The sum of Fine numbers from lo through hi inclusive. The sum from F(0) through F(6) is 85. lo must not pass hi. Each index runs from 0 to 80. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: lo, hi, count, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/fine-sum

tools.name: period_double
tools.title: Period Double
tools.description: The period-doubling bit at index n, starting at 0. It is the parity of the exponent of 2 in n+1. Bit 0 is 0, bit 1 is 1, and the first 8 bits are 01000101. n runs from 0 to 999999999999999. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/period-double

tools.name: period_double_prefix
tools.title: Period Double Prefix
tools.description: The first n period-doubling bits, as a string of the digits 0 and 1. The first 8 bits are 01000101. n runs from 1 to 4096. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/period-double-prefix

tools.name: period_double_sum
tools.title: Period Double Sum
tools.description: The number of 1s in the first n period-doubling bits, from index 0 through n-1. The first 8 bits have three 1s, and the first 100 bits have 33. n runs from 0 to 999999999999999. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/period-double-sum

tools.name: cantor_bit
tools.title: Cantor Bit
tools.description: The Cantor bit of n. It is 1 when every base-3 digit of n is 0 or 1, and 0 when a digit is 2. Bit 0 is 1, bit 2 is 0, and bit 4 is 1. n runs from 0 to 999999999999999. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cantor-bit

tools.name: cantor_count
tools.title: Cantor Count
tools.description: How many integers from 0 through n have only the digits 0 and 1 in base 3. The count through 0 is 1, through 2 is 2, and through 8 is 4. n runs from 0 to 999999999999999. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cantor-count

tools.name: two_squares
tools.title: Two Squares
tools.description: How many integer pairs (x, y), counting order and signs, satisfy x^2 + y^2 = n. There is 1 for 0, 4 for 1, and 8 for 5. n runs from 0 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/two-squares

tools.name: two_squares_pair
tools.title: Two Squares Pair
tools.description: Nonnegative integers x and y with x <= y and x^2 + y^2 = n, choosing the greatest y. 5 is 1 and 2. 25 is 0 and 5. A number that is not a sum of two squares is rejected. n runs from 0 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, x, y. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/two-squares-pair

tools.name: three_squares
tools.title: Three Squares
tools.description: Whether n is a sum of three integer squares, and one nonnegative witness x <= y <= z when it is. It is impossible exactly when n = 4^power * odd with odd congruent to 7 mod 8. 3 is 1, 1, 1. 7 is impossible. n runs from 0 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: n, possible, power, odd, x, y, z. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/three-squares

tools.name: four_squares
tools.title: Four Squares
tools.description: Four nonnegative integers w <= x <= y <= z with w^2 + x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = n. Every nonnegative integer has one. 7 is 1, 1, 1, 2. n runs from 0 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: n, w, x, y, z. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/four-squares

tools.name: square_obstruction
tools.title: Square Obstruction
tools.description: Write n = 4^power * odd, with odd not divisible by 4. blocked is true when odd is congruent to 7 mod 8, which is exactly when n is not a sum of three squares. 7 and 28 are blocked. 6 is not. n runs from 0 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, power, odd, blocked. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/square-obstruction

tools.name: liouville
tools.title: Liouville
tools.description: Liouville's function lambda(n) = (-1) to the number of prime factors of n, counted with multiplicity. lambda(1) is 1, lambda(2) is -1, and lambda(4) is 1. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/liouville

tools.name: liouville_sum
tools.title: Liouville Sum
tools.description: The sum of Liouville's lambda(k) from 1 through n. The sum through 10 is 0, and the sum through 30 is -4. n runs from 1 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/liouville-sum

tools.name: mertens
tools.title: Mertens
tools.description: The Mertens function M(n), the sum of the Mobius function mu(k) from 1 through n. M(1) is 1, M(10) is -1, and M(100) is 1. n runs from 1 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/mertens

tools.name: mertens_max
tools.title: Mertens Max
tools.description: The largest absolute value of the Mertens function M(k) for k from 1 through n, and the smallest k where it occurs. Through 10 the maximum is 2 at k = 5. Through 100 it is 4 at k = 31. n runs from 1 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: n, value, at. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/mertens-max

tools.name: prime_power
tools.title: Prime Power
tools.description: If n is a prime power p^k with k at least 1, return that prime and the exponent. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/prime-power

tools.name: square_part
tools.title: Square Part
tools.description: The largest square dividing n. 1 gives 1, 8 gives 4, 12 gives 4, and 18 gives 9. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/square-part

tools.name: square_free_part
tools.title: Square Free Part
tools.description: n divided by its largest square factor. 12 gives 3, 18 gives 2, 36 gives 1, and 45 gives 5. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/square-free-part

tools.name: powerful
tools.title: Powerful
tools.description: Whether n is powerful: 1, or every prime factor's exponent is at least 2. 1, 8, and 36 are powerful. 12 is not. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/powerful

tools.name: cubefull
tools.title: Cubefull
tools.description: Whether n is cubefull: 1, or every prime factor's exponent is at least 3. 1 and 8 are cubefull. 36 is powerful but not cubefull. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cubefull

tools.name: achilles
tools.title: Achilles
tools.description: Whether n is an Achilles number: powerful, but not a perfect power. 72 and 108 are Achilles. 36 is a square, and 1 is a perfect power, so neither is Achilles. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/achilles

tools.name: sigma_k
tools.title: Sigma K

Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sigma-k

tools.name: abundancy
tools.title: Abundancy

tools.name: unitary_count
tools.title: Unitary Count

Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/unitary-count

tools.name: happy

tools.name: wedderburn_mod

tools.name: superfactorial
tools.title: Superfactorial
tools.description: The superfactorial sf(n), the product of k! for k from 1 through n. sf(1) is 1, sf(3) is 12, and sf(4) is 288. n runs from 1 to 20. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/superfactorial

tools.name: kurepa_mod
tools.title: Kurepa Mod
tools.description: K(n) mod m for the Kurepa function, the sum of k! from 0 through n-1. The modulus is a positive decimal integer, and zero is rejected. n runs from 1 to 200. The residue is smaller than the modulus. Returns JSON with: n, mod, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/kurepa-mod

tools.name: next_prime
tools.title: Next Prime
tools.description: The least prime greater than or equal to n. 0, 1, and 2 all give 2. 14 gives 17. 10000000 gives 10000019. n runs from 0 to 10000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/next-prime

tools.name: prev_prime
tools.title: Prev Prime
tools.description: The greatest prime less than or equal to n. 2 gives 2, 10 gives 7, and 10000000 gives 9999991. n runs from 2 to 10000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/prev-prime

tools.name: prime_count
tools.title: Prime Count
tools.description: pi(n), the number of primes less than or equal to n. pi(0) and pi(1) are 0, pi(10) is 4, pi(100) is 25, and pi(10000000) is 664579. n runs from 0 to 10000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/prime-count

tools.name: prime_nth
tools.title: Prime Nth
tools.description: The kth prime. The 1st is 2, the 10th is 29, the 100th is 541, and the 664579th is 9999991. k runs from 1 to 664579. Returns JSON with: k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/prime-nth

tools.name: prime_gap
tools.title: Prime Gap
tools.description: The prime at or below n, the next prime after that one, and the difference. At 10 the prime is 7, the next is 11, and the gap is 4. At 11 the gap from 11 to 13 is 2. n runs from 2 to 10000000. Returns JSON with: n, prime, next, gap. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/prime-gap

tools.name: popcount
tools.title: Popcount
tools.description: The number of 1 bits in n. 0 has none, 255 has 8, and 256 has 1. n runs from 0 to 999999999999999. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/popcount

tools.name: bit_length
tools.title: Bit Length
tools.description: The bit length of n: 0 for 0, and one more than the position of the highest 1 bit otherwise. 1 has length 1, 255 has length 8, and 256 has length 9. n runs from 0 to 999999999999999. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/bit-length

tools.name: bit_reverse
tools.title: Bit Reverse
tools.description: Reverse the lowest width bits of n. 13 reversed in width 4 is 11. 1 reversed in width 8 is 128. n must be smaller than 2^width. width runs from 1 to 62, and n runs from 0 to 999999999999999. Returns JSON with: n, width, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/bit-reverse

tools.name: hamming_dist
tools.title: Hamming Dist
tools.description: The Hamming distance of a and b: how many bit positions differ. 13 and 7 differ in 2 places. 0 and 0 differ in none. Both run from 0 to 999999999999999. Returns JSON with: a, b, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/hamming-dist

tools.name: bit_subset
tools.title: Bit Subset
tools.description: Whether every 1 bit of a is also a 1 bit of b. 3 is a bit-subset of 7. 3 is not a bit-subset of 5. 0 is a bit-subset of 0. Both run from 0 to 999999999999999. Returns JSON with: a, b, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/bit-subset

tools.name: kronecker
tools.title: Kronecker
tools.description: The Kronecker symbol (a/n) for any integers a and n. (2/7) is 1, (3/7) is -1, (2/4) is 0, and (1/0) is 1. Both a and n run from -1000000000000 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: a, n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/kronecker

tools.name: legendre_symbol
tools.title: Legendre Symbol
tools.description: The Legendre symbol (a/p) for an odd prime p. (2/7) is 1, (3/7) is -1, and (-1/5) is 1. p must be an odd prime. a runs from -1000000000000 to 1000000000000, and p runs from 0 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: a, p, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/legendre-symbol

tools.name: quadratic_residue
tools.title: Quadratic Residue
tools.description: Whether a is a square modulo an odd prime p, counting 0 as a square. 2 is a square mod 7, and 3 is not. -1 is a square mod 5 and not mod 7. p must be an odd prime. Returns JSON with: a, p, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/quadratic-residue

tools.name: padic
tools.title: Padic
tools.description: The p-adic valuation v_p(n): how many times the prime p divides n. v_2(12) is 2, v_3(12) is 1, and v_5(12) is 0. p must be prime. n runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: p, n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/padic

tools.name: factorial_valuation
tools.title: Factorial Valuation
tools.description: The p-adic valuation of n!, the exponent of the prime p in n!. v_2(10!) is 8, v_3(10!) is 4, and v_2(100!) is 97. p must be prime. n runs from 0 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: p, n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/factorial-valuation

tools.name: mult_order
tools.title: Mult Order
tools.description: The multiplicative order of a modulo n: the least positive k with a^k = 1 mod n. The order of 2 mod 7 is 3, and the order of 3 mod 7 is 6. a must be coprime to n. n runs from 2 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: a, n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/mult-order

tools.name: primitive_root
tools.title: Primitive Root
tools.description: Whether g is a primitive root modulo the prime p. 3 is a primitive root mod 7, and 2 is not. 1 is a primitive root mod 2. p must be prime and runs from 2 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: g, p, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/primitive-root

tools.name: least_primitive_root
tools.title: Least Primitive Root
tools.description: The least primitive root modulo the prime p. It is 1 for 2, 3 for 7, 5 for 23, and 6 for 41. p must be prime and runs from 2 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: p, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/least-primitive-root

tools.name: mod_inverse
tools.title: Mod Inverse
tools.description: The inverse of a modulo m, the residue from 0 to m-1 with a*inverse = 1 mod m. The inverse of 3 mod 7 is 5, and the inverse of -1 mod 7 is 6. There is no inverse when a and m share a factor. m runs from 2 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: a, m, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/mod-inverse

tools.name: power_mod
tools.title: Power Mod
tools.description: a to the power e, reduced modulo m. 2^10 mod 1000 is 24, 3^5 mod 7 is 5, and (-2)^3 mod 7 is 6. A zero exponent gives 1, including 0^0, except modulo 1 where every power is 0. e runs from 0 to 1000000000000, and m runs from 1 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: a, e, m, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/power-mod

tools.name: eulerian
tools.title: Eulerian
tools.description: The Eulerian number A(n, k), the number of permutations of n with k ascents. A(4, 1) is 11, A(5, 2) is 66, and A(n, 0) is 1. k runs from 0 through n-1. n runs from 1 to 60. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/eulerian

tools.name: eulerian_row
tools.title: Eulerian Row
tools.description: The Eulerian row A(n, 0) through A(n, n-1), comma-separated. The row for 5 is 1,26,66,26,1. It is symmetric and sums to n!. n runs from 1 to 12. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/eulerian-row

tools.name: eulerian_sum
tools.title: Eulerian Sum
tools.description: The sum of Eulerian numbers A(n, k) for k from lo through hi. The whole row sums to n!. A(4, 0) through A(4, 1) is 12. lo must not pass hi, and hi must be an ascent of n. n runs from 1 to 60. Returns JSON with: n, lo, hi, count, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/eulerian-sum

tools.name: eulerian_mod
tools.title: Eulerian Mod
tools.description: A(n, k) mod m for the Eulerian numbers. The modulus is a positive decimal integer, and zero is rejected. k must be an ascent of n. n runs from 1 to 60. Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/eulerian-mod

tools.name: eulerian_poly
tools.title: Eulerian Poly
tools.description: The Eulerian polynomial A_n(x) = sum A(n, k) * x^k. A_3(2) is 13, A_4(1) is 24, and A_5(0) is 1. n runs from 1 to 20, and x runs from 0 to 10. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, x, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/eulerian-poly

tools.name: central_binomial
tools.title: Central Binomial
tools.description: The nth central binomial coefficient (2n)!/(n!)^2. C(0) is 1, C(1) is 2, C(5) is 252, and C(10) is 184756. n runs from 0 to 200. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/central-binomial

tools.name: central_sum
tools.title: Central Sum
tools.description: The sum of central binomial coefficients from lo through hi. The sum from C(0) through C(5) is 351. lo must not pass hi. Each index runs from 0 to 200. Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/central-sum

tools.name: central_mod
tools.title: Central Mod
tools.description: C(n) mod m for the central binomial coefficients. C(10) mod 7 is 5. The modulus is a positive decimal integer, and zero is rejected. n runs from 0 to 200. Returns JSON with: n, mod, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/central-mod

tools.name: central_index

tools.description: The index n with central binomial coefficient C(n) equal to value. 1 is index 0, and 2 is index 1. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/central-index

tools.name: central_ratio

tools.description: The ratio C(n)/C(n-1) = (4n-2)/n in lowest terms. For 1 it is 2/1, for 2 it is 3/1, and for 3 it is 10/3. n runs from 1 to 200. Returns JSON with: n, num, den. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/central-ratio

tools.name: lucky
