tools.name: triperfect
tools.title: Triperfect
tools.description: Whether sigma(n) = 3*n. 120 and 672 are triperfect. 6 and 28 are perfect, so they are not. n runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, sigma, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/triperfect

tools.name: betrothed
tools.title: Betrothed
tools.description: Whether n and m are betrothed: the sum of proper divisors of n is m+1, and the sum for m is n+1, with m different from n. 48 pairs with 75, and 140 pairs with 195. The partner is 0 when n is not betrothed. n runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, partner, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/betrothed

tools.name: ore
tools.title: Ore
tools.description: Whether n is an Ore number: n times the divisor count is divisible by sigma(n), so the harmonic mean of the divisors is an integer. 1 gives 1, 6 gives 2, and 140 gives 5. 10 does not. The mean is 0 when n is not an Ore number. n runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, mean, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ore

tools.name: leyland
tools.title: Leyland
tools.description: The Leyland number x^y + y^x. 2 and 2 give 8, 2 and 3 give 17, and 3 and 3 give 54. x and y each run from 2 to 20. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: x, y, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/leyland

tools.name: wagstaff
tools.title: Wagstaff
tools.description: The Wagstaff number (2^p + 1)/3 for an odd prime p. p=3 gives 3, p=5 gives 11, and p=7 gives 43. An even number or a composite is rejected. p runs from 3 to 127. Returns JSON with: p, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/wagstaff

tools.name: wagstaff_prime
tools.title: Wagstaff Prime
tools.description: Whether the Wagstaff number (2^p + 1)/3 is prime. p=3, 5, 7, and 31 are. p=29 is not. An even number or a composite is rejected. p runs from 3 to 31. This checks the given prime. Returns JSON with: p, wagstaff, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/wagstaff-prime

tools.name: polite
tools.title: Polite
tools.description: Whether n is polite: it is a sum of two or more consecutive positive integers. Every number that is not a power of two is polite. 3, 6, and 9 are. 1, 2, 4, and 8 are not. n runs from 1 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/polite

tools.name: polite_split
tools.title: Polite Split
tools.description: The shortest sum of consecutive positive integers equal to n. 9 is 4+5, so it starts at 4 and has length 2. 6 is 1+2+3. 100 starts at 18 and has length 5. A power of two is rejected. n runs from 1 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: n, start, length. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/polite-split

tools.name: totient_sum
tools.title: Totient Sum
tools.description: The sum of Euler totients from 1 through n. Through 1 it is 1, through 5 it is 10, and through 10 it is 32. n runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/totient-sum

tools.name: farey_count
tools.title: Farey Count
tools.description: How many reduced fractions lie in the Farey sequence of order n, from 0/1 through 1/1. Order 1 has 2, order 5 has 11, and order 6 has 13. The count is one more than the totient sum. n runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/farey-count

tools.name: visible_points
tools.title: Visible Points
tools.description: How many lattice points (x, y) with 1 <= x,y <= n are visible from the origin, meaning gcd(x, y) = 1. The 1-square has 1, the 2-square has 3, and the 5-square has 19. n runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/visible-points

tools.name: gcd_sum
tools.title: Gcd Sum
tools.description: The sum of gcd(x, y) over 1 <= x,y <= n. Through 1 it is 1, through 5 it is 37, and through 10 it is 189. n runs from 1 to 5000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/gcd-sum

tools.name: cototient
tools.title: Cototient
tools.description: The cototient n - totient(n): how many integers from 1 to n share a factor with n. 1 gives 0, 6 gives 4, 9 gives 3, and 10 gives 6. n runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cototient

tools.name: josephus
tools.title: Josephus
tools.description: The surviving seat in the Josephus circle. Seats are 1 through n, counting starts at 1, and every k-th remaining person leaves. 5 people and every 2nd leave seat 3. 41 people and every 3rd leave seat 31. n and k run from 1 to 10000. Returns JSON with: n, k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/josephus

tools.name: josephus_k2
tools.title: Josephus K2
tools.description: The Josephus survivor when every 2nd person is eliminated. Write n = 2^m + l with l < 2^m. The survivor is 2*l + 1. 5 gives 3, 10 gives 5, and 41 gives 19. n runs from 1 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/josephus-k2

tools.name: josephus_first
tools.title: Josephus First
tools.description: The first person eliminated in the Josephus circle. With 5 people and every 2nd, person 2 leaves first. With every 3rd, person 3 leaves first. A circle of one person has nobody to eliminate. n runs from 2 to 10000 and k from 1 to 10000. Returns JSON with: n, k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/josephus-first

tools.name: josephus_order
tools.title: Josephus Order
tools.description: The elimination order in the Josephus circle, comma-separated, not including the survivor. With 5 people and every 2nd, the order is 2,4,1,5. n runs from 2 to 24 and k from 1 to 100. Returns JSON with: n, k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/josephus-order

tools.name: josephus_place
tools.title: Josephus Place
tools.description: When a seat is eliminated. Place 1 is the first person out. The survivor has place n. With 5 people and every 2nd, seat 2 has place 1 and seat 3 has place 5. The seat must be from 1 to n. n runs from 1 to 10000. Returns JSON with: n, k, seat, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/josephus-place

tools.name: fourth_sum
tools.title: Fourth Sum
tools.description: The sum of the first n fourth powers, n(n+1)(2n+1)(3n^2+3n-1)/30. The sum through 0 is 0, through 1 is 1, and through 10 is 25333. n runs from 0 to 10000. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/fourth-sum

tools.name: fifth_sum
tools.title: Fifth Sum
tools.description: The sum of the first n fifth powers, n^2(n+1)^2(2n^2+2n-1)/12. The sum through 10 is 220825. n runs from 0 to 10000. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/fifth-sum

tools.name: sixth_sum
tools.title: Sixth Sum
tools.description: The sum of the first n sixth powers, n(n+1)(2n+1)(3n^4+6n^3-3n+1)/42. The sum through 10 is 1978405. n runs from 0 to 10000. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sixth-sum

tools.name: seventh_sum
tools.title: Seventh Sum
tools.description: The sum of the first n seventh powers, n^2(n+1)^2(3n^4+6n^3-n^2-4n+2)/24. The sum through 10 is 18080425. n runs from 0 to 10000. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/seventh-sum

tools.name: odd_square_sum
tools.title: Odd Square Sum
tools.description: The sum of the first n odd squares: 1^2 + 3^2 + ... + (2n-1)^2 = n(4n^2-1)/3. One term is 1, two terms are 10, and four terms are 84. n runs from 0 to 1000000. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/odd-square-sum

tools.name: cyclotomic
tools.title: Cyclotomic
tools.description: The cyclotomic value Phi_n(a) for an integer a at least 2. Phi_1(2) is 1, Phi_5(2) is 31, Phi_6(3) is 7, and Phi_1(5) is 4. n runs from 1 to 40 and a from 2 to 20. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: n, a, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cyclotomic

tools.name: cyclotomic_one
tools.title: Cyclotomic One
tools.description: Phi_n(1). It is 0 when n is 1. When n is a power of a prime p, it is p. Otherwise it is 1. Phi_4(1) is 2, Phi_6(1) is 1, and Phi_9(1) is 3. n runs from 1 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cyclotomic-one

tools.name: cyclotomic_neg
tools.title: Cyclotomic Neg
tools.description: Phi_n(-1). n=1 gives -2, n=2 gives 0, n=6 gives 3, and n=10 gives 5. n runs from 1 to 120. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cyclotomic-neg

tools.name: cyclotomic_coeff
tools.title: Cyclotomic Coeff
tools.description: The coefficient of x^k in Phi_n. Phi_6 has coefficients 1, -1, 1, so k=1 is -1. The coefficient of x^7 in Phi_105 is -2. k past the degree is rejected. n runs from 1 to 120. Returns JSON with: n, k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cyclotomic-coeff

tools.name: cyclotomic_height
tools.title: Cyclotomic Height
tools.description: The largest absolute coefficient of Phi_n. Phi_1 through Phi_15 have height 1. Phi_105 has height 2. n runs from 1 to 120. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cyclotomic-height

tools.name: sqrt_period
tools.title: Sqrt Period
tools.description: The period of the continued fraction of sqrt(d). sqrt(2) has period 1, sqrt(3) has period 2, sqrt(7) has period 4, and sqrt(13) has period 5. A square is rejected. d runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: d, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sqrt-period

tools.name: sqrt_cf
tools.title: Sqrt Cf
tools.description: The continued fraction of sqrt(d): the integer part a0 and the repeating block, comma-separated. sqrt(2) is 1 with block 2. sqrt(19) is 4 with block 2,1,3,1,2,8. A square is rejected. d runs from 1 to 10000. Returns JSON with: d, a0, length, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sqrt-cf

tools.name: neg_pell
tools.title: Neg Pell
tools.description: Whether x^2 - d*y^2 = -1 has a positive integer solution. It does exactly when the continued-fraction period of sqrt(d) is odd. d=2, 5, and 13 do. d=3, 6, and 7 do not. A square is rejected. d runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: d, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/neg-pell

tools.name: sqrt_tail
tools.title: Sqrt Tail
tools.description: The last term of the repeating block of sqrt(d), which is twice the integer part. sqrt(2) ends in 2, sqrt(3) ends in 2, and sqrt(10) ends in 6. A square is rejected. d runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: d, a0, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sqrt-tail

tools.name: neg_pell_count
tools.title: Neg Pell Count
tools.description: How many nonsquares from 1 through n have an odd continued-fraction period, so the negative Pell equation is solvable. Through 2 there is 1, through 10 there are 3, and through 13 there are 4. n runs from 1 to 500. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/neg-pell-count

tools.name: self_number
tools.title: Self Number
tools.description: Whether n is a self number: no m has m plus its digit sum equal to n. 1, 20, and 108 are. 2, 10, and 21 are not. n runs from 1 to 1000000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/self-number

tools.name: self_count
tools.title: Self Count
tools.description: How many self numbers are at most n. Through 1 there is 1, through 10 there are 5, through 20 there are 6, and through 100 there are 13. n runs from 1 to 20000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/self-count

tools.name: self_next
tools.title: Self Next
tools.description: The smallest self number that is at least n. 1 stays 1, 2 gives 3, 10 gives 20, and 21 gives 31. n runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/self-next

tools.name: self_nth
tools.title: Self Nth
tools.description: The kth self number. The 1st is 1, the 5th is 9, the 10th is 64, and the 20th is 165. k runs from 1 to 2000. Returns JSON with: k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/self-nth

tools.name: self_seed
tools.title: Self Seed
tools.description: m plus the sum of its decimal digits. 1 gives 2, 5 gives 10, 19 gives 29, and 99 gives 117. A self number is a number this map never hits. m runs from 0 to 1000000000000. Returns JSON with: m, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/self-seed

tools.name: factoradic
tools.title: Factoradic
tools.description: The factorial-base digits of n, from the highest place down through the 0! place, comma-separated. The last digit is always 0. 0 is "0", 5 is "2,1,0", 23 is "3,2,1,0", and 463 is "3,4,1,0,1,0". n runs from 0 to 999999999999999. Returns JSON with: n, length, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/factoradic

tools.name: factoradic_decode
tools.title: Factoradic Decode
tools.description: The integer value of factorial-base digits. The last entry is the 0! place. [2, 1, 0] is 5 and [3, 2, 1, 0] is 23. A digit in the k! place must be from 0 through k. At most 20 digits. Returns JSON with: digits, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/factoradic-decode

tools.name: factoradic_digit
tools.title: Factoradic Digit
tools.description: The digit of the k! place of n. It is floor(n / k!) mod (k+1), and it is 0 when k! exceeds n. The 0! digit is always 0. For 463 the 5! digit is 3 and the 4! digit is 4. k runs from 0 to 20. Returns JSON with: n, k, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/factoradic-digit

tools.name: factoradic_length
tools.title: Factoradic Length
tools.description: How many factorial-base digits n has, including the 0! place. 0 has 1, 5 has 3, 23 has 4, and 24 has 5. n runs from 0 to 999999999999999. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/factoradic-length

tools.name: factoradic_sum
tools.title: Factoradic Sum
tools.description: The sum of the factorial-base digits of n. 0 sums to 0, 5 sums to 3, 23 sums to 6, and 463 sums to 9. n runs from 0 to 999999999999999. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/factoradic-sum

tools.name: binary_partition
tools.title: Binary Partition
tools.description: The number of binary partitions of n, partitions into powers of two. b(0) is 1. Odd n copies b(n-1). Even n is b(n-1) plus b(n/2). b(1) is 1, b(4) is 4, and b(10) is 14. n runs from 0 to 1000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/binary-partition

tools.name: binary_partition_sum
tools.title: Binary Partition Sum
tools.description: The sum of the binary partition numbers from b(0) through b(n). Through 0 it is 1, through 4 it is 10, through 10 it is 60, and through 20 it is 390. n runs from 0 to 1000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/binary-partition-sum

tools.name: plane_partition
tools.title: Plane Partition
tools.description: The number of plane partitions of n. The values begin 1, 1, 3, 6, 13, 24, so n=5 is 24, n=9 is 282, and n=10 is 500. n runs from 0 to 80. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/plane-partition

tools.name: plane_partition_sum
tools.title: Plane Partition Sum
tools.description: The sum of the plane partition numbers from 0 through n. Through 0 it is 1, through 2 it is 5, through 4 it is 24, and through 5 it is 48. n runs from 0 to 80. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/plane-partition-sum

tools.name: overpartition
tools.title: Overpartition
tools.description: The number of overpartitions of n. The first part may be overlined. The values begin 1, 2, 4, 8, 14, 24, so n=4 is 14 and n=10 is 232. n runs from 0 to 80. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/overpartition

tools.name: highly_abundant
tools.title: Highly Abundant
tools.description: Whether sigma(n) is strictly larger than sigma(m) for every m below n. 1, 6, 8, and 16 are. 5 and 9 are not. n runs from 1 to 10000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/highly-abundant

tools.name: superabundant
tools.title: Superabundant
tools.description: Whether sigma(n)/n is strictly larger than sigma(m)/m for every m below n. The ratio is compared as sigma(n)*m against sigma(m)*n. 1, 2, 4, 6, and 12 are. 3, 8, and 16 are not. n runs from 1 to 10000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/superabundant

tools.name: primitive_abundant
tools.title: Primitive Abundant
tools.description: Whether n is abundant and no proper divisor is abundant. 12, 18, 20, and 70 are. 24 is not, because 12 divides it. 6 is perfect, so it is not. n runs from 1 to 10000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/primitive-abundant

tools.name: abundance
tools.title: Abundance
tools.description: sigma(n) minus 2n. A perfect number gives 0, an abundant number gives a positive value, and a deficient number gives a negative value. 12 gives 4, 6 gives 0, 10 gives -2, and 1 gives -1. n runs from 1 to 10000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/abundance

tools.name: perfect_totient
tools.title: Perfect Totient
tools.description: Whether n equals the sum of its iterated totients down to 1. The sum includes the final 1 and excludes n. 3, 9, 15, and 27 are. 1, 2, and 6 are not. n runs from 1 to 100000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/perfect-totient

tools.name: balanced_prime
tools.title: Balanced Prime
tools.description: Whether n is prime and equal to the average of the previous prime and the next prime. 5, 53, 157, and 1103 are. 2, 3, 7, and 11 are not. n runs from 1 to 5000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/balanced-prime

tools.name: prime_triplet
tools.title: Prime Triplet
tools.description: Whether n starts a prime triplet: n, n+2, and n+6 are prime, or n, n+4, and n+6 are prime. 5, 7, 11, and 13 do. 3 and 19 do not. n runs from 1 to 10000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/prime-triplet

tools.name: prime_triplet_count
tools.title: Prime Triplet Count
tools.description: How many prime-triplet starters are at most n. Through 3 there are none, through 5 there is 1, through 13 there are 4, and through 17 there are 5. n runs from 1 to 5000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/prime-triplet-count

tools.name: chen_prime
tools.title: Chen Prime
tools.description: Whether n is prime and n+2 is either prime or a product of two primes, counted with multiplicity. 2, 41, and 47 are. 43 is not, because 45 has three prime factors. n runs from 1 to 10000. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/chen-prime

tools.name: depolignac
tools.title: Depolignac
tools.description: Whether odd n is never a prime plus a power of two, counting 2^0. 1 qualifies, because nothing smaller works. 3 is 2+1, so it does not. 127 is the next, and 905 is another.
